newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World mulls Hip Hing spinoff - paper.
newsitem.headline: New World mulls Hip Hing spinoff - paper.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd is considering spining off its construction and civil engineering unit Hip Hing Construction Co Ltd, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Monday.
New World has approached investment banks to study the spinoff's feasibility but no final decision has yet been made, the report said. It gave no further details.
New World officials were not available for comment.
Turnover of Hip Hing rose 14 percent year on year to HK$5.323 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1995, and net profit rose 16 percent to HK$150 million, the report said.
Hip Hing was 59 percent owned by New World as at June 30, 1995. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
